message: Arthur, I also have some duplicates. I'm missing Richard II, Henry V, the first and third parts of Henry VI, Timon of Athens, Pericles, King Lear, and Hamlet. If those are some of your duplicates, I'd be very grateful if you'd let me write you a check for them, or I can offer you some of my duplicates: Henry VIII, Cymbeline, and A Midsummer Night's Dream. Mine have been handed down through four generations, so there's fading and spine wear, but they're in pretty good shape otherwise.
